children: The Shangai Composite Index went up by 29 points or 0.76 percent on Wednesday to close at 3894 points.
The rise was led by Sanan Optoelectron (2.57%), Inner Mongolia BaoTou Steel (1.90%) and Zijin Mining (1.45%).
On the downside, the weakerst performers were Sany Heavy Industry (-7.13%), Petrochina (-2.79%) and Great Wall Motor (-2.40%).

title: The Shangai Composite Index Closes 0.76% Higher
